params.prompt:
Repaint this blockout video as a finished hand-painted gouache animation. VERTICAL 9:16 portrait frame, frame for frame: keep the exact camera move, framing, timing and every pose from the source video, and paint only what each source frame shows, adding no other characters or objects.

Character: the flame-shaped figure is Sol, exactly the mascot in the reference images (the turnaround sheet shows his shape from every side). Round, plump gumdrop body with a red outer layer, an orange middle layer and a broad cream inner flame for the face. At rest his face is plain smooth cream with exactly two small tall navy #1C2447 oval eyes set low and close together, solid dark with no whites or highlights, and nothing else on it: nothing is drawn above his eyes and nothing below them. His eyes change ONLY as the beats below say; copy his eyes from each source frame exactly, the same shape, size and place. Short stubby rounded red-orange arm nubs and two tiny blunt stubby red feet; his arm nubs stay the same short length in every frame and never stretch or grow. Sol wears nothing. Sol gives off no sparks, particles or smoke. His layers and face move together as one body with a small soft wobble that settles. He keeps the same size and the same place in the frame as in the source video. The small floating marks near him (music notes, an exclamation mark, a sweat drop, dots, a light bulb, a star, yellow dashes) appear ONLY in the frames where the source video shows them, in the same place and size, and vanish when the source stops showing them.

Scene: a small sunny bathroom, inside a white bathtub alcove. The tub floor is smooth glossy white. The walls of the alcove are pale aqua square tiles with white grout lines. Warm daylight with soft cool shadows, so the room has depth and glow. On the far wall are one silver shower head, one round window glowing with warm cream light, one small white shelf holding one coral bottle, one lilac bottle and one yellow rubber duck, and one silver lever tap; none of them ever moves or changes. The shower is running: blue water drops fall straight down from the shower head in a narrow spray and land in one round pale-blue puddle on the tub floor. Paint the drops as falling water, exactly where the source video shows them. Along the left side of the tub hangs ONE mustard-yellow shower curtain with soft vertical pleats and a pale cream band along its bottom hem, on one silver rod with silver rings. CURTAIN RULE: it is the same single curtain in every frame, the same colour, with the same pleats and the same cream hem; it bends and swings ONLY as the source video shows and never tears, opens, wraps around Sol or changes length. 

Beats: 1. CAMERA: one steady shot. The camera faces Sol from the first frame and only eases slowly closer to him until the last frame, exactly as in the source video. It never swings, jumps or changes angle, and the curtain, the wall and the shower stay in the same places in the frame the whole time. 2. Sol stands on the tub floor beside the curtain's cream hem. For the first 0.35 seconds he is turned a little toward the curtain and looks sideways at its hem; his eyes are two navy ovals. 3. From 0.35 to 0.7 seconds he turns to face the camera, tilts back and looks UP above the camera. He holds that upward look, listening, with a very small slow sway, until 2.9 seconds. His eyes stay two navy ovals. He blinks once at 1.6 seconds. 4. From 2.95 to 3.45 seconds he nods once, clearly: his whole body dips forward and comes back up, and his eyes are still two navy ovals. 5. At 3.75 seconds his eyes become two small upward-curved navy arcs, like ^ ^, he gives one small bounce with both arm nubs lifted, and two little fans of yellow dashes appear above his sides; at 4.3 seconds the dashes are gone and his nubs are down. His eyes stay two small upward-curved navy arcs, like ^ ^ to the last frame. PUDDLE RULE: the shallow pale-blue puddle under his feet is there in the first frame, exactly as in the reference frame, and stays the same size and shape to the last frame; nothing else appears on the floor. GROUND RULE: his feet rest on the tub floor in every frame and his shadow lies under his feet. ARM RULE: his arm nubs stay the same short stubs in every frame; he never reaches for or holds anything. 

Style: match the painted reference frame from this same film exactly: the same bathroom, the same aqua tiles, the same yellow curtain, the same shallow pale-blue puddle of water on the white tub floor around Sol's feet, the same paint treatment, the same light and the same Sol. Do not copy the reference frame's camera angle or pose; take every object's place and every pose from the source video. Soft matte gouache painting with visible brushwork, broad simplified shapes, layered colour, softened painted edges and subtle paper texture on Sol, the props and the room alike. Forms defined by light and colour. No ink outlines, no black linework, not glossy 3D, not vector art. Smooth natural motion, no motion blur, stable background paint texture. No text, no letters, no captions, no speech, no music.
